from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted for cause of action matching."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category of the case (e.g., 民事，行政)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
